rules.prepare:
if [ "$AELTRA_BUILD_FOR" = "cross-tools" ]; then EXTRA_OPTS="--with-sysroot=/usr" elif [ "$AELTRA_BUILD_FOR" = "tools" ]; then EXTRA_OPTS="--with-sysroot=/tools --program-prefix=${AELTRA_TARGET_TYPE}-" else EXTRA_OPTS="--with-sysroot=/usr" fi
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR/configure" \ --prefix="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" \ --build="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" \ --host="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" \ --target="$AELTRA_TARGET_TYPE" \ --disable-gdbtk \ --disable-shared \ --disable-readline \ --enable-tui \ --without-guile \ --with-system-readline \ --with-expat \ --with-system-zlib \ --with-lzma \ --with-python="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/python3" \ --disable-nls \ $EXTRA_OPTS
rules.install:
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------- # SETUP # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
if [ "$AELTRA_BUILD_FOR" = "cross-tools" ]; then PROGRAM_PREFIX_FROM="${AELTRA_TARGET_TYPE}-" PROGRAM_PREFIX_TO="" elif [ "$AELTRA_BUILD_FOR" = "tools" ]; then PROGRAM_PREFIX_FROM="${AELTRA_TARGET_TYPE}-" PROGRAM_PREFIX_TO="$PROGRAM_PREFIX_FROM" else PROGRAM_PREFIX_FROM="" PROGRAM_PREFIX_TO="" fi
FULL_INSTALL="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/all"
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" make DESTDIR="$FULL_INSTALL" install
find "$FULL_INSTALL" -name "*.la" -exec rm '{}' \; rm -fr "$FULL_INSTALL/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/share/info" rm -fr "$FULL_INSTALL/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/share/man"
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------- PKG_PATH="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/gdb" # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
install -d -m 0755 "$PKG_PATH/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin"
for PROG in gcore gdb gdb-add-index; do if [ -e "$FULL_INSTALL/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/$PROGRAM_PREFIX_FROM$PROG" ]; then mv "$FULL_INSTALL/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/$PROGRAM_PREFIX_FROM$PROG" \ "$PKG_PATH/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/$PROGRAM_PREFIX_TO$PROG" fi done
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------- PKG_PATH="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/gdb-common" # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
install -d -m 0755 "$PKG_PATH/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX"
for SUBDIR in share include; do mv "$FULL_INSTALL/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/$SUBDIR" \ "$PKG_PATH/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/" done
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------- PKG_PATH="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/gdbserver" # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
install -d -m 0755 "$PKG_PATH/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin"
for PROG in gdbserver; do if [ -e "$FULL_INSTALL/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/$PROG" ]; then mv "$FULL_INSTALL/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/$PROG" \ "$PKG_PATH/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin" fi done
for SUBDIR in lib; do if [ -d "$FULL_INSTALL/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/$SUBDIR" ]; then mv "$FULL_INSTALL/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/$SUBDIR" \ "$PKG_PATH/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/" fi done
